So you feel bad and you want to feel better?

Want to do better and excel in life? The Holy Trinity of Wellness is the foundation of a happy life. Regardless of creed or culture, these three pillars are considered the most influential across the world.

The Do and Do Not

In my path of progression, I've found it useful to view actions in a do or do not fashion. Do nots are things which need to be eradicated, such as addictions, procrastination's, and self deprecating actions. The dos are things which you need to do more of, or start doing altogether. The Holy Trinity of Wellness is the foundation of the Do's.

Pillar 1: Meditation

A clear mind is paramount. Without it procrastination and complacency become a bigger and bigger obstacle. A clear mind is necessary for focus, and discipline. It is necessary to begin and maintain new habits, and to be able to say goodbye to the old. Meditation, even if ten minutes a day, can profoundly effect your life in the long run. Of all the habits you could begin now, meditation is number 1.

Pillar 2: Diet and Exercise

There's no better way to increase confidence than exercise, and no better way to prevent disease and illness than a good diet.

The benefits of exercise are too numerous to count. Confidence, focus, energy. Exercise isn't an option, its a necessity for operating at your best.

Diet is profoundly important. You are what you eat. If you have no experience or knowledge for how to have a healthy diet, a simple start is to avoid the three white poisons: sugar, salt, flour. Starches and sugars do our bodies very little good. Make your own meals, and avoid bullshit. EAT REAL FOOD. Diet will effect your energy levels, mood, and focus to a far greater extent than most realize.

Pillar 3: Reading

Leaders are always readers. Reading is exercise for the mind. It enhances the fluency of your speech, gives you a greater ability to describe, and all around increases communication skills. And all this is just from reading fiction. But non-fiction is the juicy part. Knowledge is power. Be a perpetual learner, always be studying. The power of discerning information and applying it to your life is the only way to improve, and the best source of information is books. Read every day. I always suggest nonfiction, but be sure to throw in fiction in there, as it will spark your imagination and creativity.

Conclusion

These three pillars should be your starting place, and foundation going forward. If you don't know where to start in bettering yourself, The Holy Trinity of Wellness is your guide going forward. Later I will post on the don't side of things, and address the top 5 habits you should quit.
